dialogue-before-taking-the-orb-of-protec.npc: Don't speak to me you insignificant wretch! Die in the name of Khazard!

after-taking-the-orb-of-protection.npc: You think you're so clever. You know nothing!
I'll crush you and those pesky little green men!

after-giving-the-orb-of-protection-to-ki.npc: Go back to your pesky little green friends.
You're out of your depth traveller. These orbs are part of a much larger picture.

after-giving-the-orb-of-protection-to-ki.player: They're stolen goods, now give them here!

after-giving-the-orb-of-protection-to-ki.npc: Ha, you really think you stand a chance? I'll crush you.

after-killing-him-in-tree-gnome-village.npc: Fool, warriors blessed by Khazard don't die. You can't kill that which is already dead. However I can kill you!
